dotnet--runtime--60764.en: The constructor stack begins on a timer worker. Joining it to creation recovers Program.Main as the initiator of this Foo state machine.
dotnet--runtime--60764.zh: 构造函数的物理栈起于计时器工作线程。拼回创建栈后，可以确定这次 Foo 状态机由 Program.Main 发起。

drogonframework--drogon--2331.en: Two request entries use shared_lookup. The stopped sample's owner and the recorded creator chain identify profile_entry as the origin of the blocked request.
drogonframework--drogon--2331.zh: 两个请求入口都使用 shared_lookup。将停止现场归到具体协程后，沿创建关系可以确认卡住的是由 profile_entry 发起的请求。

tokio-rs--tokio--6315.en: The matched spawn and helper-body stacks identify which parent launched the delayed task in the controlled LIFO-slot run.
tokio-rs--tokio--6315.zh: 在受控的 LIFO 槽位复现中，将任务创建栈和任务体执行栈对齐，能找到被延迟调度的任务由哪个父任务发起。

pgjdbc--pgjdbc--1951.en: The pin sample locates the JDBC read. The matched virtual-thread start supplies the earlier application dispatch path.
pgjdbc--pgjdbc--1951.zh: JFR 钉住事件指出 JDBC 读取位置。用同一个虚拟线程 ID 拼回启动记录后，可以找到早先的应用请求分派路径。

nodejs--node--36126.en: The resumed diagnostic contains sub. The Promise creation stack restores its synchronous initiator, main.
nodejs--node--36126.zh: 恢复后的诊断栈只有 sub。拼上对应 Promise 的创建栈后，可以找回同步发起者 main。

nodejs--node--48511.en: The early post-await diagnostic in foo omits main and indirectCall. The matching Promise creation record retains both.
nodejs--node--48511.zh: foo 第一次 await 之后的诊断栈缺少 main 和 indirectCall。匹配到的 Promise 创建记录保留了这两个调用者。

golang--go--22289.en: Runtime creator IDs recover the chain from the blocked goroutine through its ancestors in the controlled fixture.
golang--go--22289.zh: 在受控程序里，用运行时创建者 ID 将阻塞的 goroutine 追溯到多级创建者。

python--cpython--91048.en: The suspended task is linked to the task creation in f2. The crossed-await control checks creator and current waiter independently.
python--cpython--91048.zh: 挂起现场被连回 f2 中的任务创建位置。交叉 await 对照对创建者和当前等待者做了独立核对。

python--cpython--88831.en: Finalization evidence identifies the pending task, and the identity-matched capture traces the task to its creation.
python--cpython--88831.zh: 终结现场识别出仍未完成的任务，再通过匹配实例的采集记录追溯它的创建位置。

aio-libs--async-lru--528.en: The active stack shows bar. Its child-task creation stack recovers foo and main and identifies the first caller among several waiters.
aio-libs--async-lru--528.zh: 当前栈显示 bar。拼回子任务的创建栈后可恢复 foo 和 main，并从多个等待者中区分最早的发起者。

kludex--starlette--1438.en: The task creation link connects the request middleware to the background execution that received cancellation.
kludex--starlette--1438.zh: 任务创建关系把请求中间件和收到取消的后台执行连在一起。

fastapi--fastapi--709.en: Joining the pending subscription stack to request-task creation identifies which request was still live at shutdown.
fastapi--fastapi--709.zh: 将仍在等待的订阅栈拼回请求任务的创建处，可以确定服务关闭时仍存活的是哪个请求。

sqlalchemy--sqlalchemy--8145.en: The cleanup sample links back to the same Task created by main. Pool records then identify the matching checked-out connection left by the cancellation.
sqlalchemy--sqlalchemy--8145.zh: 把清理现场连回 main 创建的同一个任务。连接池记录进一步核对出取消后遗留的已借出连接。

grpc--grpc-kotlin--299.en: Captured Kotlin Job identities connect the two failure samples to their respective launch sites, even with identical messages and reversed reply order.
grpc--grpc-kotlin--299.zh: 用采集到的 Kotlin Job 身份，将两处失败分别匹配到各自的启动位置。消息相同、响应顺序反转时也能区分两次调用。

kotlin--kotlinx.coroutines--2327.en: Job lifecycle joins attribute the identical requestSuspend failures to the separate async and launch callers.
kotlin--kotlinx.coroutines--2327.zh: 沿 Job 生命周期将两个相同的 requestSuspend 失败分别连回 async 和 launch 的发起者。

kotlin--kotlinx.coroutines--2604.en: The throw sample and its continuation chain are joined to the runBlocking Job; this recovers the caller path across suspension.
kotlin--kotlinx.coroutines--2604.zh: 将抛异常时的续体栈连回 runBlocking 创建的 Job，恢复挂起前的调用路径。

python-trio--trio--285.en: Creation-to-cancellation attribution identifies which of two similarly executing tasks came from the unresponsive branch.
python-trio--trio--285.zh: 把取消现场连回任务的创建位置，区分执行路径相似的两个任务，定位无响应的一侧。

huggingface--huggingface_hub--2521.en: Two requests shared a URL. The captured task lineage and response identities let the warning be attributed to submit_alpha.
huggingface--huggingface_hub--2521.zh: 两个请求使用同一 URL。沿任务创建关系并核对响应对象身份，可以将告警归到 submit_alpha。

automattic--mongoose--15317.en: The validation stack starts at Document.invalidate. The Promise creation record recovers the originating model.save call in runDemo.
automattic--mongoose--15317.zh: 校验栈起于 Document.invalidate。拼上 Promise 创建记录可以找回 runDemo 中发起的 model.save。

automattic--mongoose--8691.en: The creation record shows Query.then starting exec internally and recovers the application context missing from the error.
automattic--mongoose--8691.zh: 创建记录显示 Query.then 在内部启动 exec，并恢复错误栈里丢失的应用调用上下文。

axios--axios--2387.en: Matching Promise, Error, and ClientRequest identities lets the two reports be traced to separate axios.get callers.
axios--axios--2387.zh: 对齐 Promise、Error 和 ClientRequest 身份后，可以把两条错误记录分别追溯到对应的 axios.get 调用者。

knex--knex--2500.en: The rejection's Promise identity identifies the creation stack in the application test where the missing async caller originated.
knex--knex--2500.zh: 通过发生拒绝的 Promise 身份，可以恢复应用测试中缺失的异步调用者。

sequelize--sequelize--12044.en: Stitching the second create call to its catch reconnects the lost application call site to the driver-error path.
sequelize--sequelize--12044.zh: 将第二次 create 的创建栈拼到 catch 现场，把错误栈中缺失的应用调用行连到驱动报错路径。

sidorares--node-mysql2--530.en: The two query Promise identities tie similar failures to readAccount and readInvoice separately.
sidorares--node-mysql2--530.zh: 两次查询的 Promise 身份将相似的错误分别归到 readAccount 和 readInvoice。

sindresorhus--got--2277.en: Promise and timer identities recover which initiating caller hit its connect-phase deadline in the timing control.
sindresorhus--got--2277.zh: 用 Promise 和计时器身份核对超时现场，找出触发连接阶段时限的发起者。

typeorm--typeorm--11499.en: The same SQL produces the same error text in two callers. Matching each Promise and await continuation distinguishes importOrders from refreshCatalog.
typeorm--typeorm--11499.zh: 两个调用者执行相同 SQL 并得到相同报错。拼接各自 Promise 的创建栈和 await 恢复栈，可以区分 importOrders 和 refreshCatalog。

vincit--objection.js--1618.en: At the custom thenable boundary, query-object identity reconnects each rejection to its own application creation site.
vincit--objection.js--1618.zh: 在自定义 thenable 边界，用查询对象身份将各次拒绝连回对应的应用创建位置。

omnilib--aiosqlite--87.en: Task joins identify which concurrent gather callers received each lastrowid observation, so the reported values can be compared with the correct committed rows.
omnilib--aiosqlite--87.zh: 通过任务拼接找出每次 lastrowid 观测来自哪个 gather 子任务，进而用正确的已提交数据行核对返回值。

tortoise--tortoise-orm--2060.en: The join identifies the gather caller whose defaults were lost and traces its task to the conflict-handling path that returned the competing caller's value.
tortoise--tortoise-orm--2060.zh: 拼接确定了 gather 中哪一个调用者的默认值丢失，并将它的任务追溯到返回竞争方数据的冲突处理路径。
